# Beat The Scam

> Plain-English UK consumer-protection guides covering scams, fraud, and how to spot them before paying. New guide published daily by an editorial team focused on UK consumers.

## Guides

### Crypto Scams

- [Binance Impersonation Scam UK: How to Spot Fake Messages and Protect Your Crypto](https://beatthescam.com/guides/binance-impersonation-scam-uk/): Criminals send fake Binance emails, SMS messages and social media messages claiming urgent action is needed on your account. They trick you into clicking malicious links or revealing your password, then drain your crypto wallet.
- [Bitcoin ATM Scam UK: How Criminals Trick You at Cash Machines](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bitcoin-atm-scam-uk/): Bitcoin ATM scams target UK residents by impersonating banks, tax authorities, or tech support, pressuring victims to withdraw cash and convert it to Bitcoin at ATMs. The money is irreversible and the scammers disappear once the transaction is complete.
- [Bitcoin Scam UK: Spot a Fake Crypto Investment](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bitcoin-scam-uk/): Approached about a Bitcoin 'investment opportunity' promising guaranteed returns? How to spot a Bitcoin scam, protect your wallet, and report it in the UK.
- [Crypto Investment Scam UK: Spot a Fake Platform](https://beatthescam.com/guides/crypto-investment-scams-uk-protection/): Approached about a crypto investment with celebrity endorsements or guaranteed returns? Spot a crypto investment scam and protect yourself in the UK.
- [Crypto Recovery Scam UK: How Fraudsters Pose as Recovery Experts](https://beatthescam.com/guides/crypto-recovery-scam-uk/): Crypto recovery scams target people who have already lost money in investment fraud or hacking. Scammers impersonate recovery companies and charge upfront fees while stealing more funds or personal data.
- [Cryptocurrency Payment Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Crypto Exchanges](https://beatthescam.com/guides/cryptocurrency-payment-scam-uk/): Scammers impersonate legitimate cryptocurrency exchanges to trick UK users into sending money or cryptocurrency that cannot be recovered. This guide explains the exact tactics used, how to verify genuine platforms, and what to do if you've been targeted.
- [Fake Crypto Exchange UK: How to Spot and Avoid Scams](https://beatthescam.com/guides/fake-crypto-exchange-uk/): Fake crypto exchanges are designed to look identical to legitimate platforms like Coinbase or Kraken, but they steal your login details and funds. This guide shows you the specific warning signs and verification steps UK residents need to know.
- [NFT Scam UK: How to Spot Fake NFT Platforms and Protect Your Money](https://beatthescam.com/guides/nft-scam-uk/): NFT scams in the UK use fake websites and social media to lure investors into buying worthless digital assets or stealing login credentials. We explain how these scams work and the specific warning signs to watch for.

### Email Scams

- [Amazon Scam Emails: How to Spot a Fake Amazon Email (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/amazon-order-scam-email-checklist/): Got an Amazon email about an order problem, refund, or 'account locked'? How to tell a genuine Amazon email from a phishing scam — and check safely.
- [CEO Fraud Email Scam UK: How to Spot and Stop Impersonation Attacks](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ceo-fraud-email-scam-uk/): CEO fraud, also called business email compromise (BEC), is a targeted scam where criminals impersonate company executives to trick employees into transferring funds or revealing sensitive information. This guide shows you the exact warning signs and verification steps UK businesses and employees need to know.
- [Companies House Email Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Official Emails](https://beatthescam.com/guides/companies-house-email-scam-uk/): Fraudsters send emails pretending to be from Companies House, the UK government agency that registers companies. They demand urgent payment for filing fees, renewals, or threaten to strike your company off the register unless you act immediately.
- [DVLA Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Tax or Fine Email](https://beatthescam.com/guides/dvla-email-scam-uk/): Got a DVLA email about car tax, a refund, a fine, or your licence? How to spot a fake DVLA email, check safely on GOV.UK, and report it in the UK.
- [Email Account Takeover Scam UK: How to Spot and Stop It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/email-account-takeover-scam-uk/): Email account takeover is when criminals break into your email account to steal money, personal data, or impersonate you to others. This guide explains how the scam works, what warning signs to watch for, and exactly what to do if you think your account has been compromised.
- [Festival Lineup Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Presale](https://beatthescam.com/guides/festival-lineup-email-scam-uk/): Got an email about a festival lineup announcement with a presale ticket link? How to spot a fake festival email scam and buy tickets safely.
- [HMRC Tax Rebate Email Scam: Spot a Fake (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hmrc-tax-rebate-email-scam/): An HMRC email saying you're owed a tax rebate, with a link to claim? Real rebates aren't claimed through an email link — how to spot the scam and check safely.
- [HSBC Phishing Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hsbc-phishing-email-scam-uk/): An email claiming to be HSBC asks you to verify your details urgently, or risk suspension? Check it carefully before you click anything.
- [Microsoft Account Suspended Email Scam: UK Guide to Spotting Fake Messages](https://beatthescam.com/guides/microsoft-account-suspended-email-scam-uk/): Scammers send convincing emails claiming your Microsoft account has been suspended and asking you to verify your identity urgently. These emails lead to fake login pages designed to steal your password, recovery email, and payment card details.
- [NatWest Phishing Emails: Spot a Fake NatWest Email (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/natwest-phishing-email-uk/): A NatWest email about 'unusual activity' or 'verify your account', with a button to click? How to tell a genuine NatWest email from phishing — and check safely.
- [Netflix Billing Email Scam UK: How to Spot Fake Payment Notices](https://beatthescam.com/guides/netflix-billing-email-scam-uk/): Netflix billing email scams target UK subscribers by sending urgent messages claiming payment has failed or your account needs updating. Victims are directed to fake login pages where their email, password, and payment information are stolen.
- [PayPal Account Limited Email Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/paypal-account-limited-email-scam-uk/): Scammers send fake PayPal emails claiming your account is limited, asking you to verify your identity or payment details. We show you how to spot the fake emails and stay safe.
- [Santander Email Scam: How to Spot a Fake Bank Email (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/santander-email-scam-uk/): A Santander email about a locked account or 'verify now'? How to spot a fake Santander email, check it safely, and report phishing in the UK.
- [Sextortion Email Scam UK: How to Spot and Stop It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/sextortion-email-scam-uk/): Sextortion is a blackmail scam delivered by email, where criminals claim to have intimate footage or screenshots and demand payment to keep quiet. These emails are almost always false, but they exploit fear and shame to pressure victims into paying.
- [TV Licence Scam Email UK: How to Spot a Fake](https://beatthescam.com/guides/tv-licence-email-scam-uk/): Genuine TV Licensing payment emails come from specific sender addresses - here's how to check before clicking any link.

### Employment Scams

- [Data Entry Job Scams UK: Spot Fake Work-from-Home Offers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/data-entry-job-scam-uk/): A 'data entry' or 'typing' job from home that pays well and asks for an upfront fee or tasks? How to spot the scam and find genuine work safely.
- [Indeed Job Scams UK: How to Spot a Fake Recruiter](https://beatthescam.com/guides/indeed-job-scam-uk/): A great-paying Indeed job that asks for an upfront fee or moves you to WhatsApp? How to spot a fake recruiter — and why a real UK employer never charges you to work.
- [Job Offer Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'You're Hired' Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/job-offer-scam-uk/): Got an unexpected job offer by text or WhatsApp with great pay and no interview? How to spot a fake job offer, check the employer, and report it in the UK.
- [LinkedIn Job Scam UK: Spot a Fake Recruiter Offer](https://beatthescam.com/guides/linkedin-job-scam-guide-uk/): An unsolicited LinkedIn message offers a role that seems too easy or too well-paid? Verify the recruiter independently before sharing anything.
- [Mystery Shopper Scam UK: How to Spot Fake Jobs and Protect Yourself](https://beatthescam.com/guides/mystery-shopper-scam-uk/): Mystery shopper scams target job seekers with promises of easy money for shopping and reviewing. Scammers pose as legitimate mystery shopping companies, but ask you to pay upfront fees or complete suspicious tasks that result in financial loss.
- [Recruitment Agency Scams UK: Spot a Fake Job Offer](https://beatthescam.com/guides/recruitment-agency-scam-uk/): A 'recruitment agency' asking for an upfront fee, your bank details, or ID before any real job? How to spot a fake agency and check it's genuine.
- [Remote Work Scam UK: How to Spot a Fake Job Offer](https://beatthescam.com/guides/remote-work-scam-uk-2026/): Offered a remote job with no real interview and an upfront fee to 'start'? Here's how to tell a genuine offer from a scam one.
- [Work from Home Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Job Offers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/work-from-home-scam-uk/): Work from home scams target UK job seekers with promises of quick money for minimal effort, often using fake job boards and impersonated companies. This guide shows you exactly how these scams operate and what steps to take if you've been contacted.

### Fraud & Impersonation

- [beatthescam.com Guide: Spotting and Avoiding UK Consumer Scams](https://beatthescam.com/guides/beatthescamcom-guide-spotting-and-avoiding-uk-consumer-scams/): Complete guide to identifying common UK scams and protecting yourself. Learn warning signs, reporting procedures, and defence strategies from verified consumer threats.
- [Charity Scam UK: Spot a Fake Donation Appeal](https://beatthescam.com/guides/charity-donation-scam-checklist/): Asked to donate to a charity appeal by phone, text, or social media? How to spot a fake charity scam, check it's genuine, and give safely in the UK.
- [Conveyancing Fraud UK: How to Spot and Stop Property Purchase Scams](https://beatthescam.com/guides/conveyancing-fraud-uk/): Conveyancing fraud is a sophisticated crime where criminals impersonate your solicitor or conveyancer to intercept property funds. This guide explains how the scam works, what warning signs to watch for, and how to protect yourself during a property transaction.
- [Deed Fraud UK Property Scam: How to Protect Your Home](https://beatthescam.com/guides/deed-fraud-uk-property-scam/): Deed fraud involves criminals forging documents to claim ownership of your property or use it as security for loans without your knowledge. This guide explains how the scam works, what to watch for, and the urgent steps to take if you suspect your property has been targeted.
- [Driveway Cowboy Scam UK: Spot a Fake Contractor](https://beatthescam.com/guides/driveway-cowboy-scam-uk/): An unsolicited caller offers cheap driveway or roof repairs using 'leftover materials'? How to spot a doorstep cowboy trader and report it in the UK.
- [Google Voice Verification Code Scam UK: Don't Share That Code](https://beatthescam.com/guides/google-voice-verification-scam/): Someone asks you to read back a Google verification code to 'prove you're real'? It's a scam to hijack your number. Here's how it works and what to do.
- [Identity Theft UK: Warning Signs & What to Do](https://beatthescam.com/guides/identity-theft-uk/): Noticed an unrecognised account or a sudden credit-file surprise? Here's how identity theft actually happens in the UK, and what to do about it first.
- [Impersonation Scams: When Criminals Pretend to Be Your Bank or the Police](https://beatthescam.com/guides/impersonation-scams-when-criminals-pretend-to-be-your-bank-or-the-police/): Learn how impersonation scams work in the UK, recognise the warning signs, and protect yourself from criminals posing as trusted organisations. This guide helps consumers avoid losing money to fake calls and messages.
- [Mandate Fraud UK: How Scammers Steal Direct Debit Access](https://beatthescam.com/guides/mandate-fraud-uk-businesses/): Mandate fraud is when criminals impersonate your supplier or service provider and convince you to alter your direct debit instructions. The scammer redirects your regular payments to their own bank account, potentially costing thousands before you notice.
- [Recovery Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'Get Your Money Back' Firm](https://beatthescam.com/guides/refund-recovery-scam-warning-signs/): Lost money to a scam and now a 'recovery agent' offers to get it back for a fee? How to spot a recovery scam, avoid a second loss, and report it in the UK.
- [WhatsApp 'Hi Mum' Scam UK: Spot a Fake Family Text](https://beatthescam.com/guides/whatsapp-family-emergency-scam/): Got a WhatsApp from 'your child' on a new number needing urgent money? Spot the 'Hi Mum' family impersonation scam, check safely, and get money back.

### Government Impersonation

- [Benefits Fraud Text Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid DWP Impersonation](https://beatthescam.com/guides/benefits-fraud-text-scam-uk/): Criminals send fake text messages claiming to be from the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), asking you to verify your identity, confirm bank details, or click a link. These messages are designed to harvest your personal information or trick you into paying fake fines or fees.
- [Companies House Scam Letter UK: How to Spot and Report It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/companies-house-scam-letter-uk/): Scammers send official-looking letters claiming to be from Companies House, often demanding urgent payment for company registration or compliance fees. This guide explains how to spot these letters, verify genuine communications, and report them to the authorities.
- [Council Housing Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Housing Offers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/council-housing-scam-uk/): Council housing scams target people desperate for affordable accommodation by posing as local authority housing departments. Scammers demand upfront fees, deposits, or personal information, then disappear or use stolen data for identity fraud.
- [Court Summons Scam Email UK: How to Spot Fake HMCTS Messages](https://beatthescam.com/guides/court-summons-scam-email-uk/): Fraudsters send official-looking emails claiming you have an unpaid fine or court appearance, pressuring you to click links or pay immediately. This guide shows you how to verify genuine HMCTS contact and what to do if you've already responded.
- [HMRC Self Assessment Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hmrc-self-assessment-scam-uk/): Scammers send emails, texts, and letters pretending to be HMRC, claiming you owe tax or must verify your self-assessment details urgently. This guide explains how the scam works, what genuine HMRC contact looks like, and what to do if you've already engaged with a fake message.
- [Passport Renewal Scam UK: Spot a Fake HMPO Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/passport-renewal-scam-uk/): A text or email says your passport application needs an urgent fee? Check your own application on gov.uk first.
- [Student Finance Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Loan Offers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/student-finance-scam-uk/): Student Finance scams target UK students with fake loan offers, fake repayment demands, and phishing emails that look like official government communications. Scammers use urgency and authority to trick you into sharing bank details, passwords, or paying upfront fees.
- [TV Licence Scam Letter UK: Spot a Fake Demand](https://beatthescam.com/guides/tv-licence-scam-letter-uk/): Got a letter demanding payment for an unpaid TV licence with a threat of prosecution? How to spot a fake TV Licensing letter and report it in the UK.
- [UKVI Visa Scam UK: Spot a Fake Home Office Email](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ukvi-visa-scam-uk/): Got an email claiming to be from UKVI about your visa or immigration application, demanding urgent payment? How to spot a fake UKVI scam and report it.
- [Universal Credit Scams UK: Spot a Fake DWP Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/universal-credit-scam-uk/): A text, call, or 'agent' offering help to claim Universal Credit, a grant, or an advance? How to spot a Universal Credit scam and protect your claim and money.

### Investment & Finance Scams

- [Bond Scam UK: How Fraudsters Steal via Fake Investments](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bond-scam-uk/): Bond scams promise unusually high returns on investment bonds, then ask for upfront fees or deposits that disappear. Fraudsters often impersonate legitimate investment firms or create convincing fake websites to steal thousands from unsuspecting UK residents.
- [Clone Firm Investment Scam UK: How to Spot Fake FCA-Regulated Companies](https://beatthescam.com/guides/clone-firm-investment-scam-uk/): Clone firm scams target UK savers by impersonating legitimate, FCA-regulated investment companies. Fraudsters create near-identical websites and contact details to convince you to invest money that disappears immediately.
- [Debt Management Scam UK: How to Spot Fake Debt Relief Companies](https://beatthescam.com/guides/debt-management-scam-uk/): Debt management scams target people with existing debts by impersonating regulated firms and demanding upfront fees for services that never materialise. Scammers often use pressure tactics and false promises to negotiate your debts, then disappear with your money.
- [Debt Relief Scam UK: Spot a Fake Debt Help Company](https://beatthescam.com/guides/debt-relief-scam-uk/): Contacted by a company promising to wipe or reduce your debt for an upfront fee? How to spot a debt relief scam, find free help, and report it in the UK.
- [Fake Trading Platform Scams UK: How to Spot Fraudulent Investment Sites](https://beatthescam.com/guides/fake-trading-platform-uk/): Fake trading platforms are websites designed to look like real investment brokers, where scammers trick you into depositing money or handing over sensitive financial information. These sites often target UK investors with promises of high returns on forex, cryptocurrency, or stocks.
- [Forex Trading Scam UK: Spot a Fake Broker](https://beatthescam.com/guides/forex-trading-scam-uk/): Promised guaranteed forex returns on social media? Check any broker on the FCA's Firm Checker before you deposit a single penny.
- [IVA Scam UK: Spot a Fake Debt Solution Firm](https://beatthescam.com/guides/iva-scam-uk/): Contacted about an IVA that will 'write off most of your debt'? How to spot a fake IVA offer, find genuine advice, and report it in the UK.
- [Land Banking Scam UK: Spot a Fake Land Investment](https://beatthescam.com/guides/land-banking-scam-uk/): Offered cheap land 'certain to get planning permission' as an investment? How to spot a land banking scam, check safely, and report it in the UK.
- [Money Mule Scam UK: Spot a 'Job' Moving Money](https://beatthescam.com/guides/money-mule-scam-uk/): Offered easy money for letting cash pass through your bank account? How to spot a money mule recruitment scam and avoid serious legal trouble in the UK.
- [Pension Cold Call Scam UK: How to Spot and Stop This Scam](https://beatthescam.com/guides/pension-cold-call-scam-uk/): Pension cold call scams target people by pretending to be legitimate financial advisers offering pension reviews or early access schemes. The scammers convince you to transfer your pension pot into fraudulent accounts, leaving your retirement savings gone forever.
- [Ponzi Scheme UK Warning: How to Spot Investment Scams](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ponzi-scheme-uk-warning/): Ponzi schemes are illegal investment frauds that collapse when new investor money runs out. In the UK, scammers often pose as legitimate investment firms, using social media and WhatsApp to recruit victims and promise guaranteed high returns.
- [Recovery Room Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Debt Recovery Schemes](https://beatthescam.com/guides/recovery-room-scam-uk/): Recovery room scams promise to retrieve money lost to previous fraud, but are themselves sophisticated fraud schemes. Scammers pose as debt recovery firms, lawyers, or financial investigators to extract upfront fees and personal data from desperate victims.
- [Share Fraud UK: How to Spot and Avoid Investment Scams](https://beatthescam.com/guides/share-fraud-uk/): Share fraud is a growing threat where scammers pose as legitimate investment brokers or advisors to convince you to buy fake shares or invest in non-existent companies. This guide explains how the scam works, what to watch for, and what steps to take if you've been contacted.

Scammers create urgency by claiming your account will be suspended unless you pay immediately.
- [eBay Scams UK: How to Spot a Fake Buyer, Seller or Email](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ebay-buyer-scam-uk/): Asked to pay or deal outside eBay, or got an 'eBay' email about a held payment? How to spot the common eBay scams and keep your money protected.

- [Gumtree Scams UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Listings and Buyers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/gumtree-scam-uk-guide/): Gumtree is legitimate, but scammers use it. Here are the most common Gumtree scams targeting UK buyers and sellers, the warning signs, and how to stay safe.
- [Preloved Scam UK: Spot a Fake Seller or Listing](https://beatthescam.com/guides/preloved-scam-uk/): Buying on Preloved and asked to pay by bank transfer before you can view the item? How to spot a fake Preloved seller, buy safely, and report it.
- [Rightmove Rental Scam UK: Spot Fake Property Listings](https://beatthescam.com/guides/rightmove-rental-scam-uk/): Renting a place you found on Rightmove? How to spot a fake listing or landlord, avoid losing a deposit to a 'pay to hold it' con, and report it in the UK.
- [Shpock scam UK: how to spot and avoid fake sellers on the app](https://beatthescam.com/guides/shpock-scam-uk/): Shpock is a legitimate UK secondhand marketplace app, but scammers actively impersonate genuine sellers or create fake listings to defraud users. This guide shows you exactly how the scam works and what to check before you buy or sell anything.
- [Vinted Buyer Scam UK: Spot Fake 'Payment' Cons](https://beatthescam.com/guides/vinted-buyer-scam-uk/): Selling on Vinted and a buyer wants to pay off-app or 'confirm your card'? How to spot a Vinted buyer scam, keep your payment safe, and report it.
- [Vinted Scams UK: Warning Signs for Buyers and Sellers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/vinted-scam-warning-uk/): Buying or selling on Vinted? The main risk on both sides is being pushed off the app — here's how Vinted's protection works and what to watch for.

### Payment Scams

- [Advance Fee Scam UK: How to Spot and Stop Upfront Payment Frauds](https://beatthescam.com/guides/advance-fee-scam-uk/): Advance fee scams are fraudulent schemes where criminals demand payment upfront for something valuable—a loan, inheritance, job, or prize—that doesn't exist. They target UK residents across email, text, phone, and dating apps, and cost victims thousands of pounds annually.
- [Apple Pay Scam UK: Spot Fake Security Alerts & Texts](https://beatthescam.com/guides/apple-pay-scam-uk/): Got a call, text, or email about 'suspicious Apple Pay activity' or a locked account? How to spot an Apple Pay scam and report it in the UK.
- [Bank Transfer Scams UK: How to Spot a 'Safe Account' Con](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bank-transfer-scam-uk/): Asked to move money to a 'safe account', or to pay by bank transfer under pressure? How to spot a bank-transfer scam, check safely on 159, and claim it back.
- [Chargeback Scam UK: How Chargeback Fraud Works and How to Avoid It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/chargeback-scam-uk/): Chargeback scams let a buyer keep the goods and get their money back, leaving the seller out of pocket. Here's how chargeback fraud works and how to protect yourself.
- [Invoice Fraud UK: How to Verify a Payment Safely](https://beatthescam.com/guides/invoice-fraud-uk-businesses/): A supplier email says their bank details changed? Always verify by phone on a number you already have on file before you pay.
- [Invoice Redirection Scam UK: Spot Fake Payment Requests](https://beatthescam.com/guides/invoice-redirection-scam-checklist/): A supplier email says their bank details have changed? Verify it by phone on a number you already have — never one from the email itself.
- [Monzo Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'Suspicious Activity' Alert](https://beatthescam.com/guides/monzo-scam-transfer-uk/): Got a call, text, or in-app message claiming 'suspicious activity' on your Monzo account? How to spot a Monzo scam, check safely, and report it in the UK.
- [Overpayment Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid This Common Fraud](https://beatthescam.com/guides/overpayment-scam-uk/): Overpayment scams trick you into sending money back after receiving a payment that appears legitimate but is actually fraudulent. We'll show you how to recognise these scams and what to do if you've been targeted.
- [PayPal Friends and Family Scam UK: How to Spot and Avoid It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/paypal-friends-family-scam-uk/): The PayPal Friends and Family scam tricks UK users into sending money to criminals by posing as sellers, buyers, or trusted contacts. Unlike standard PayPal transactions, Friends and Family payments offer no protection — once sent, the money is nearly impossible to recover.
- [Push Payment Fraud UK: How Scammers Trick You Into Sending Your Own Money](https://beatthescam.com/guides/push-payment-fraud-uk/): Push payment fraud is when a scammer impersonates your bank, a business, or a trusted contact to convince you to send money directly from your account. Unlike other scams, the victim authorises the payment themselves, making it harder for banks to recover the funds.
- [Revolut Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'Security' Contact](https://beatthescam.com/guides/revolut-scam-uk/): A message or call claims to be Revolut security asking you to move money to a 'safe account'? Stop and check inside the Revolut app.
- [Starling Bank Scam UK: Spot a Fake Fraud Alert](https://beatthescam.com/guides/starling-bank-scam-uk/): Got a text, call, or email claiming to be Starling about suspicious activity on your account? How to spot a Starling scam and report it in the UK.
- [Wedding Photographer Scam UK: How to Spot Fake Bookings & Protect Your Money](https://beatthescam.com/guides/wedding-photographer-scam-uk/): Wedding photographer scams involve fraudsters impersonating real professionals or creating fake portfolios to collect deposits for non-existent services. They typically target engaged couples under time pressure, requesting large upfront payments via bank transfer or digital wallet.
- [Wedding Venue Deposit Scam UK: How to Spot Fake Booking Confirmations](https://beatthescam.com/guides/wedding-venue-deposit-scam-uk/): Wedding venue deposit scams target engaged couples by creating fake booking confirmations and invoices that look legitimate. Scammers use stolen venue details and pressure tactics to extract deposits before the couple discovers the deception.
